rows.text: The Monetary Policy Committee approved a framework for exchange rate management
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) today attended a regular monthly
The MPC has been closely monitoring recent baht appreciation and assessing its implications for the Thai economy.
The committee judges that recent gain in baht is largely attributable to foreign investors' confidence in the strength of the Thai economy.
On the positive side, the baht appreciation has been conducive to business investment to enhance their productivity.
However, the stronger baht also has negative impact on exporters, economy to remain resilient, which is in line with other agencies' assessments.
